note: Sanitized capture of stream-json control responses. Removed: account e-mail and org name, commands, agents, pid, output-styles dir, remote-control and session-state flags, session totals, and the context detail lists (agents, skills, slash commands, memory files, MCP tools, message breakdown, grid). run_A = container env as rendered by compose; run_B = ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL unset. Each get_context_usage/<id> follows set_model/<id>; get_context_usage/initial is the state before any set_model. A set_model Claude Code rejected is stored as {"error": <text>}.
